Recording & execution rules

Result codes

PPass — all expected results were observed.
FFail — at least one expected result was not observed. Record the defect / deviation reference.
BBlocked — execution could not proceed because a required precondition, test data item or test-kit state was not available. Blocked is not a Pass.
NRNot Run — the test case was not executed in this run.

How to run each case

Establish the Preconditions, then perform the Procedure steps exactly as written. Compare what you observe with the Expected Result and capture the Required Evidence. Record the Overall Result (P/F/B/NR), tester and date, and raise a defect/deviation for any Fail.

Secrets

Do not record passwords, OTP seeds or other authentication secrets in this protocol, its evidence, or your notes here — use the controlled credential source.

About this console

This is a personal aid for running the selected protocol and keeping evidence handy — it is not the official protocol document. Transcribe final P/F/B/NR results, evidence references and defect IDs into the controlled record.
